derivedDefinition.whatCounts: A contiguous textual label that organizes substantive document content or its outline; the role vocabulary distinguishes title, content hierarchy, and other structural elements.
derivedDefinition.whatDoesNotCount: Navigation, TOC, running-header, caption, list-item, table-label, metadata/front-matter, decorative, body-fragment, and other explicitly non-task structural elements remain rich evidence but are excluded from the final heading projection.
derivedDefinition.ambiguity: Document title treatment is represented as an explicit DOCUMENT_TITLE role; whether it is part of a particular reviewed projection remains an authority/profile decision, never a formatting heuristic.
derivedDefinition.spanConvention: Complete contiguous heading label, meaningful numbering/punctuation included, surrounding whitespace excluded, source-occurrence-local UTF-16 half-open offsets.

currentPromptSemantics.scope: every structurally real heading or structural label
